comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer onto roller slides above riding height, engage rear hooks, and pull-test it; candidate adjusts switch positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support, long-slide alignment, hook engagement, lowering, and pull testing versus fine sensor sliding and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer must engage both slides/hooks, carry its load, travel correctly, and pass a pull test; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center registrations.
comparison.reason: Constrained drawer installation and retention testing are different from feedback-guided mount calibration. Candidate fastener torque and drift rubric are incomplete.
